mechanism_behavior_addenda.mech.trough: Retained VPX script evidence (lines 177-188 and 516-562): the recreation initializes four balls on swTrough1-4, maps its five table trough kickers to inputs 21-17, locally advances a ball toward the eject end after occupancy changes, sends Drain to that local chain, and lets sol.1 kick swTrough1 toward the shooter lane. This is table-only topology and a simulated route; no physical trough count, sixth/jam sensor fitment, drain path, geometry, or construction is established.
mechanism_behavior_addenda.mech.launch: Retained VPX script evidence (lines 190-197 and 564-567): an impulse helper is attached to swShooter and switch 1; sol.2 calls its AutoFire method. The visible manual Plunger object is operated from the plunger key separately (lines 319-370). The output placement is therefore a shooter-trigger projection, not proof that a physical auto launcher shares the manual plunger's assembly, stroke, or path.
